patches.why: in FUSENET_MODE=dumpv4, Experiment/FUSENET-01/run.py report() writes xjfdump_v4.parquet / xjfdump_persons.json / xjfdump_report.txt and returns without fusenet_report.txt; the original run (16/11 04:00 UTC) therefore ended with FileNotFoundError at this copy, AFTER its outputs were written (log line 'FileNotFoundError ... fusenet_report.txt'), and Kaggle marked it ERROR. Skipping the two missing report files lets the stage finish; nothing that is computed changes
patches.side_effect: the rest of the 'RFSTUNE-01 report' cell (one print) and the whole 'summary' cell now run; in the original run they never ran because this cell died. The summary cell rewrites e2e_out/progress.json with five more keys (gpu, torch, lab_data, e2e, finished), so this stage's progress.json differs from the saved one (Experiment/XJF-01/out/dumpv4/e2e_out/progress.json, sha256 f28b4783..., keys code_md5 / done / exp / files / seconds / split; listed in original/OUTPUTS.sha256). No number changes; only the xjfdump_* files are read downstream (WP-I dp_sigma reads xjfdump_v4.parquet) (recorded by the fixer 18/11)
